statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because the post-payroll path continues to show meaningful two-sided retracement, while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Current policy mapping is EA_ON; the remaining post-payroll window still carries event/whipsaw Stress, with Tail dependent on whether directional efficiency rebuilds before the danger window ends.
headline: Two-sided post-payroll trade keeps Tail low as rate Stress stays extreme
body: August payrolls rose by 162,000 with unemployment unchanged at 4.1%, lifting Treasury-rate expectations. Delayed NQ at 29,567.50 remained well inside a 29,503.25–29,704.50 session range after both a sharp selloff and rebound, while broader equity performance stayed mixed. The observed path still shows meaningful counter-moves rather than persistent mean-reversion failure; Gulf supply disruption keeps background Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated during Thursday's U.S. afternoon trend-up phase, declined overnight, and returned to WATCH as Friday's payroll event approached. It stayed at 24 through the release hour, then fell to low at 14:00 UTC as the observed post-payroll path showed a large retracement and rebound rather than persistent one-way extension.
outlookSummary: Current post-payroll price discovery remains sufficiently two-sided to keep Tail low while Stress stays extreme. The remaining danger window ends at 15:30 UTC; Tail would rise only if directional efficiency rebuilds with repeated failed retracements or session-extreme holding. After the weekly close, the forecast shifts toward low Tail and elevated weekend gap/headline Stress.

forecast.analysis: Observed delayed NQ at 29,567.50 sits well inside a 29,503.25–29,704.50 session range after both a sharp post-payroll selloff and rebound. The two-sided path keeps Tail low even as rates and geopolitical Stress remain extreme.
